name: Git branch
description: Once per chat: the app compares the branch with the main branch, and the agent brings in what is newer.

action.text: If the work tree is clean and the merge has no conflicts, merge them into your branch and tell the user what came in and whether it touches this work. Otherwise tell the user and ask. Never discard changes or rewrite history. Status line: "Branch: merged 3 commits" or "Branch: behind, asked the user".
